# Resolve Real Estate

> Resolve is the name Taran Aujla, Salesperson, uses for real estate services provided through HomeLife G1 Realty Inc., Brokerage (Independently Owned and Operated), Brampton, Ontario. RECO registration 6024721. Resolve represents Ontario home sellers in complex and time-sensitive sales: mortgage arrears, power of sale, a sale that may not cover what is owed, estates and deadlines. It serves the GTA, Durham, Hamilton, Kitchener and Waterloo. Resolve is not a brokerage and does not give legal, tax or financial advice.

Contact: 365-645-7332, taran@resolverealestate.ca

## For homeowners
- [Selling a home facing power of sale](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/power-of-sale/): what power of sale is, and selling your own home before the lender does
- [After a Notice of Sale](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/notice-of-sale/): statutory timing and choices after a notice
- [Selling during power of sale](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/sell-during-power-of-sale/): listing and closing while the lender is enforcing
- [Mortgage arrears](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/mortgage-arrears/): selling a home that is behind on payments
- [When the sale may not cover what is owed](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/coordinated-sale/): a sale coordinated with the lender
- [Financial pressure](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/financial-pressure/): renewal shock and selling before payments are missed
- [Time-sensitive sales](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/time-sensitive-sales/): deadlines, relocations and estates
- [The bank sells it, or you do](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/bank-sells-it-or-you-do/): the two paths compared
- [Homeowner options](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/homeowner-options/): a free guide to the choices before selling
- [For sellers](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/sellers/): how a Resolve sale works

## For lenders and their counsel
- [Working with lenders](https://www.resolverealestate.ca/working-with-lenders/): an owner-led sale with the lender kept informed, and lender listings after possession
